# paperclip_instance_admin (Resource)

Manages instance administrator promotion and demotion for a user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "paperclip_instance_admin" "admin" {
  user_id           = data.paperclip_user.operator.id
  is_instance_admin = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) User identifier to promote or demote.

### Optional

- `is_instance_admin` (Boolean) Whether the user is an instance administrator (defaults to true).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Matches the user ID.
